### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Keep the sessions list's headers, states and times whole](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3576) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — On the Sessions page and an agent's Sessions tab, column headers, states and `Last active` times are no longer cut off. A narrower window leaves out the environment, then shows each session as a stacked row.
